source.name: NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4, daily concentration
source.citation: Fetterer, F., K. Knowles, W. N. Meier, M. Savoie and A. K. Windnagel. Sea Ice Index, Version 4. Boulder, Colorado USA. NSIDC.
source.caveat: Concentration is the fraction of sea surface covered by ice, measured by satellite passive microwave on a 25 km grid. It is NOT thickness and says nothing about what will bear a load.
